```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      dev = "ragg_png")   # CHANGED: measure text with the same font engine as the saved files
FONT <- "Liberation Sans"   # CHANGED: Arial letter widths, and it includes the Greek letter omega
```

This notebook redraws Figure 4 with the steps of the original notebook
(`../scripts/RSSC_dnds.Rmd`). It changes one input.
The value per gene family is now the PAML codeml M0 omega (one-ratio model), from
`../paml_m0_completion/paml_m0_complete.tsv` (all 9,624 families with
at least two distinct sequences; families with paralogs use a FastTree gene tree). It replaces the KaKs_Calculator value from
`Results/DNDS/RSSC_kaks2_df.csv`, which compared two halves of a joined sequence block instead of
pairs of genes.

The GO enrichment, the GO terms chosen for each panel, the plot layers, the colours and the panel
order are unchanged. Comments marked `CHANGED` show every difference from the original.
The notebook only reads files in the analysis project folder (`PROJECT_ROOT`).

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}

prj_root = paste0(Sys.getenv("PROJECT_ROOT", "."), "/")   # set PROJECT_ROOT to the analysis project folder

# CHANGED: PAML codeml M0 omega per gene family replaces the KaKs_Calculator values
# (Results/DNDS/RSSC_kaks2_df.csv). The table covers all 9,624 families with at least two
# distinct sequences: the original run, the completion run, and gene trees for families with
# paralogs (../paml_m0_completion/merge_results.py writes it).
paml_m0 <- read_tsv("../paml_m0_completion/paml_m0_complete.tsv",
                    show_col_types = FALSE)

# CHANGED: codeml returns omega = 999 when a family shows no synonymous change; omega is
# undefined there, so those families are excluded.
dnds_df <- paml_m0 %>%
  filter(run_status %in% c("ok", "skipped_existing_ok"), !is.na(omega)) %>%
  filter(omega < 999) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, omega, sequence_count)

cat("PAML M0 families with an omega:", sum(!is.na(paml_m0$omega)),
    "| excluded at the 999 boundary:", sum(paml_m0$omega >= 999, na.rm = TRUE),
    "| used:", nrow(dnds_df), "\n")

# twilight pangenome
twilight_classification <-
  read_tsv(paste0(prj_root, "Manuscript_Figures/Figure_2/Data/twilight_classification_updated.tab"),
           show_col_types = FALSE)

# CHANGED: the eggNOG annotation table is not read, because no step below uses it.

nglb_results <- read_tsv(paste0(prj_root, 'Results/Annotation/results/09_GO_annotation_table/pan_genome_reference/pan_genome_reference.GOannotation.tsv'),
                         col_names = F, show_col_types = FALSE)

gene2go <- nglb_results %>%
  separate_rows(., X2, sep = ",")

colnames(gene2go) <- c("query", "GOs")

```

## Proportions and medians for the Results text

Share of gene families with omega above 1.
```{r}
dnds_df %>%
  mutate(status = ifelse(omega > 1, 'omega > 1', 'omega <= 1')) %>%
  group_by(status) %>%
  summarise(n = n()) %>%
  mutate(percent = n / sum(n) * 100)
```

Core against accessory, as in the original notebook.
```{r}
dnds_df %>%
  mutate(gene = str_replace_all(gene, "___", "~~~")) %>%
  left_join(twilight_classification, by = c("gene"  = "gene_name")) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, omega, general_class) %>%
  filter(!is.na(general_class)) %>%
  mutate(class = ifelse(grepl("Core", general_class), 'Core', 'Accessory')) %>%
  group_by(class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            median_omega = median(omega),
            percent_omega_above_1 = mean(omega > 1) * 100)
```

Each Twilight class.
```{r}
omega_by_class <- dnds_df %>%
  mutate(gene = str_replace_all(gene, "___", "~~~")) %>%
  left_join(twilight_classification, by = c("gene" = "gene_name")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(specific_class)) %>%
  group_by(specific_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            median_omega = median(omega),
            q1 = quantile(omega, 0.25),
            q3 = quantile(omega, 0.75),
            percent_omega_above_1 = mean(omega > 1) * 100) %>%
  arrange(median_omega)

omega_by_class
write_tsv(omega_by_class, "omega_by_twilight_class.tsv")
```

Kruskal-Wallis test across Twilight classes, and pairwise Wilcoxon tests against Collection core
with Benjamini-Hochberg correction.
```{r}
class_df <- dnds_df %>%
  mutate(gene = str_replace_all(gene, "___", "~~~")) %>%
  left_join(twilight_classification, by = c("gene" = "gene_name")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(specific_class))

kruskal.test(omega ~ specific_class, data = class_df)

pairwise_vs_core <- class_df %>%
  filter(specific_class != "Collection core") %>%
  group_by(specific_class) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            p = wilcox.test(omega, class_df$omega[class_df$specific_class == "Collection core"])$p.value,
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(p_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

pairwise_vs_core
write_tsv(pairwise_vs_core, "omega_wilcoxon_vs_collection_core.tsv")
```

```{r}
library(GO.db)

go_names <-  AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db,
                                   keys = as.character(gene2go$GOs),
                                   columns = c("TERM"),
                                   keytype = "GOID")

go_names_with_ontology <-  AnnotationDbi::select(GO.db,
                                                 keys = gene2go$GOs,
                                                 columns = c("TERM", "ONTOLOGY")) %>%
  dplyr::select(TERM, ONTOLOGY)

term2name <- go_names[, c("GOID", "TERM")]
colnames(term2name) <- c("term", "name")

```

## Panel A: Core

```{r}

library(clusterProfiler)

core_enrichment <- twilight_classification %>%
  filter(general_class == "Core") %>%
  pull(gene_name) %>%
  clusterProfiler::enricher(
    universe = twilight_classification$gene_name,
    TERM2GENE = gene2go %>% dplyr::select("GOs", "query"),
    TERM2NAME = term2name
  )

core_enriched_dnds <- core_enrichment@result %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  remove_rownames() %>%
  dplyr::select(ID, Description, geneID, p.adjust) %>%
  left_join(go_names_with_ontology,
            by = c("Description" = "TERM")) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  filter(Description != "NA") %>%

  group_by(ONTOLOGY) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust) %>%
  separate_longer_delim(geneID, delim = "/") %>%
  left_join(dnds_df, by = c("geneID" = "gene")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(omega)) %>%                               # CHANGED: omega instead of kaks
  group_by(Description) %>%
  mutate(median_omega = median(omega)) %>%                # CHANGED: omega instead of kaks

  filter(!grepl("^GO:", Description)) %>%
  ggplot(., aes(x = omega, y = reorder(Description, median_omega), fill = ONTOLOGY)) +
  geom_jitter(aes(color = ONTOLOGY), size = 0.8) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, width = 1.4, linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, width = 0.1, linewidth = 0.5, outliers = F) +

  theme_bw(base_size = 26, base_family = FONT) +       # CHANGED: font family
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5),     # CHANGED: legend title above the keys
         colour = guide_legend(title.position = "top", title.hjust = 0.5)) +
  ggsci::scale_fill_d3() +
  ggsci::scale_color_d3() +
  # CHANGED: no scale_x_continuous(limits = ...). Those limits removed data before the
  # violins and boxes were computed; all values are now shown.
  ylab("") +
  # CHANGED: the same view (omega 0 to 1.5) in every panel. coord_cartesian only limits the view,
  # so values above 1.5 still count in the violins and boxes.
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1.5)) +
  xlab("ω (PAML M0)")                                # CHANGED: axis label

core_enriched_dnds

```

## Panel values, for the legend and the Results text

```{r}
panel_values <- function(p, panel) {
  p$data %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    summarise(panel = panel,
              go_terms = n_distinct(Description),
              values = n(),
              gene_families = n_distinct(geneID),
              median_omega = median(omega),
              max_omega = max(omega),
              values_above_1 = sum(omega > 1),
              values_above_1.5_outside_view = sum(omega > 1.5))
}

bind_rows(panel_values(core_enriched_dnds, "A Core"),
          panel_values(rare_enrichment_dnds, "B Rare"),
          panel_values(lineage_specific_rare_dnds, "C Lineage-specific rare"),
          panel_values(coincident_kaks, "D Co-occurring")) %>%
  write_tsv("panel_values.tsv") %>%
  print()

# Median omega for each GO term in each panel, for the per-function values in the Results text
bind_rows(core_enriched_dnds$data %>% mutate(panel = "A Core"),
          rare_enrichment_dnds$data %>% mutate(panel = "B Rare"),
          lineage_specific_rare_dnds$data %>% mutate(panel = "C Lineage-specific rare"),
          coincident_kaks$data %>% mutate(panel = "D Co-occurring")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(panel, ONTOLOGY, Description) %>%
  summarise(gene_families = n(), median_omega = median(omega), values_above_1 = sum(omega > 1),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(panel, desc(median_omega)) %>%
  write_tsv("go_term_medians.tsv")
```

## Combined figure

Same layout and size as the original `GO_kaks_plot_final.pdf` (30 x 25 in).
```{r}
# CHANGED: the combined figure is built while each output file is open, so text is measured
# with the same font engine that draws it (avoids clipped labels and an overlapping legend).
make_fig4 <- function() {
  ggpubr::ggarrange(plotlist = list(core_enriched_dnds, rare_enrichment_dnds,
                                    lineage_specific_rare_dnds, coincident_kaks),
                    nrow = 2, ncol = 2,
                    align = "none",                 # CHANGED: "hv" gave every panel the label width of the widest panel
                    common.legend = T,
                    labels = c("(A)", "(B)", "(C)", "(D)"),
                    font.label = list(size = 40, family = FONT))   # CHANGED: panel letters readable at this size
}

ragg::agg_png("Figure4_PAML_M0.png", width = 30, height = 25, units = "in", res = 100,
              background = "white")                                 # CHANGED: white background
set.seed(2026)                                                      # CHANGED: reproducible jitter
print(make_fig4())
invisible(dev.off())

cairo_pdf("Figure4_PAML_M0.pdf", width = 30, height = 25)          # CHANGED: embeds the font and prints omega
set.seed(2026)
print(make_fig4())
invisible(dev.off())
```
